items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Polito Galindez was working with Curbelo and when Curbelo get another singer, so Mario took Polito Galindez and he organized Marcelino Guerra's band

ctx.x: Well, in that particular time, I was in the Army. When Mario told me that Marcelino Guerra was coming to New York, I said: put Marcelino in my place because I have a

great respect as a artist, because he is a fine artist, and fine composer and if you were recording his numbers, and he is a great singer, I said: Mario, why don't you put Marcelino Guerra in the band? But Polito Galindez was working with Curbelo and when Curbelo get another singer, so Mario took Polito Galindez and he organized Marcelino Guerra's band, that we used to call it "Second Afro-Cubans"," Marcelino Guerra and "Second Afro-Cubans" because Varona was the pianist from our band, but he was young and was…
